title: Language Models Meet Vibration Testing for LEO Constellation Satellites with Calibrated Response Prediction from Few-show Sweeps
abstract: arXiv:2611.20579v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly drive engineering analysis end to end, turning textual records into the inputs of numerical programs, but a plausible and wrong value can pass silently into a decision. We propose deterministic validation gates for LLM-driven engineering analysis, a general paradigm in which a typed configuration produced by LLMs is consumed only after it passes deterministic checks on units, physical consistency, verbatim quotes, agreement between independent models, consistency with measurement exports and the applicability of trained models. The gates target hallucinations from two directions, since quote checking catches fabricated content while agreement between models catches errors of omission that quote checking misses. translated_title: 语言模型遇上低轨星座卫星振动测试：基于少样本扫频的响应预测校准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）正日益推动端到端的工程分析，将文本记录转化为数值程序的输入，但一个看似合理却错误的数值可能会悄无声息地进入决策过程。我们提出了面向LLM驱动工程分析的确定性验证门控，这是一种通用范式：由LLM生成的类型化配置只有在通过确定性检查——包括单位、物理一致性、逐字引用核验、独立模型之间的一致性、与测量导出数据的一致性以及已训练模型的适用性——之后才会被采用。这些门控从两个方向对抗幻觉问题：引用检查可以捕获编造的内容，而模型间一致性检查则可以捕获引用检查所遗漏的疏漏性错误。我们将该范式实例化于低轨巨型星座卫星的正弦振动验收测试中，由DeepSeek V4.1 Flash和Qwen-plus读取中文测试记录并……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出为LLM驱动的工程分析设置确定性验证门控（涵盖单位、物理一致性、引用核验、独立模型间一致性、测量数据一致性与模型适用性检查），并将其实例化于低轨巨型星座卫星的正弦振动验收测试，以防止LLM生成的看似合理却错误的数值悄然进入工程决策。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes deterministic validation gates for LLM-driven engineering analysis—checking units, physical consistency, verbatim quotes, cross-model agreement, measurement-export consistency, and model applicability—and instantiates them in sine vibration acceptance testing for LEO mega-constellation satellites to prevent plausible-but-wrong LLM outputs from silently entering engineering decisions.
